analysis:
The supplied units are docs/architecture/inference.md only: base lines 829-1195 and head lines 1-402. The head excerpt is the opening of the file, with a "Last updated: 2026-10-16" banner. It covers the CBv2 component table, GLM5Next boundary text and calibration prose. The head text for the tail sections is not supplied (head ends at 402), so I could not compare the late-file MiMo, Flash-Next, Invariants and Code map material against base. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety. No patch hunk was supplied, so I could not identify which lines changed.

The visible content is documentation only, with no code, permission, wire-format or crypto change. The prose references security-relevant controls that the next pass should check for consistency: T-041 and the SSD prefix-cache tier (30-minute TTL, coordinator-authored cacheSalt, media excluded from prefix reuse); T-028 and T-050 (media handling, with the doc stating that MemoryBackedVideoAsset never writes payloads to disk); TB-007 (native owner retention, quarantine and fail-closed refusal on unproven retirement); and A-001 (content-free client errors such as advertisedContextExceeded). Head lines 233-238 say GLM media is excluded from prefix lookup and capture. Head line 240 onward says retired owners are retained, not refunded. Base lines 1002-1006 and 1008-1010 say media remains noncacheable and target-only. Nothing visible contradicts the threat model. No new attack surface or invalidated assumption was found in the visible text. A later pass should check that any head-side change to the cache or media claims does not overstate T-041 or T-050 mitigations.
